I have designed and built the **DESKTOP light-theme SaaS Settings — Brands (Multi-Entity)** management screen for **GeoLens** (`GeoLens — Settings / Brands (Multi-Entity)`), strictly adhering to your brand guidelines and Semrush-style dual-rail chrome.

### Key Design & Functional Details:

1. **Color Palette & Visual Language:**
   - **Primary Brand Accent:** Clean precision **Teal (`#0F766E`)** with deep hover (`#115E59`), soft mint washes (`#E6F4F2`, `#F0FDFA`), and subtle teal borders (`#99F6E4`). Absolutely zero purple.
   - **Neutrals & Typography:** Background `#F5F7F8`, card surfaces pure white (`#FFFFFF`), primary ink `#0B1218`, muted labels `#5C6B76`, border lines `#E3E9ED`, rendered in crisp **Plus Jakarta Sans**.

2. **Semrush-Style Dual-Rail Left Navigation Chrome:**
   - **Far-Left Primary Icon Rail (64px):** Analysis, Brand, Monitor, Results, and an active soft-tile indicator for **Settings** with an active marker pill and collapse toggle at the bottom.
   - **Secondary Suite Navigation Panel (230px):** Categorized hierarchy showing *Entity & Setup* (**Profile**, active teal **Brands** with count badge, **Topics & tags**, **Channels**) and *Security & Billing* (**Billing**, **API keys**, **SSO**), accompanied by an entity slot allocation meter.

3. **Brands Main Content Area:**
   - **Header & Title:** *"Brands"* with an active `"Multi-entity active"` badge and subtitle: *"Own brand and competitors you monitor for AI visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews."*
   - **KPI Metric Cards (4 Grid):**
     1. *Own Brands:* `1` primary entity (`nike.com · 18 geos active`).
     2. *Tracked Competitors:* `4` active monitored rivals (*Adidas, Puma, Under Armour, Brooks*).
     3. *Rejected:* `12` excluded entities preventing noisy crawl attribution.
     4. *Pending Review:* `3` newly detected rival entities requiring triage.
   - **Actionable Toolbar:** Real-time filter search bar, multi-entity role toggle pills (*All, Own, Competitor, Pending*), status dropdown, and a primary teal `+ Add Brand` CTA.
   - **Dense Management Table:** Complete with multi-select checkboxes, brand avatars, canonical URLs, role badges (*Own Brand* vs *Competitor* vs *Candidate*), monthly LLM mention counts with trends, progress bars for AI visibility share, status badges, and inline actions (*Edit Profile, Track, Reject*). Includes pending auto-discovered contenders (*Hoka, On Running, Saucony*).

4. **Right-Hand Intelligence Side Panel (340px):**
   - **Why Track Rivals in AI:** Educational breakdown explaining why LLMs synthesize comparative recommendations and how tracking rivals prevents hallucinated brand substitutions.
   - **Suggested Citation Gaps:** 3 immediate detected competitor gaps (*"best carbon plate marathon shoes for wide feet"*, *"eco friendly recycled running shoes"*, *"best max-cushion recovery slip-on runners"*) with 1-click `Add Track` actions.
   - **Autonomous Entity Discovery Webhook:** System status card confirming live background monitoring for new entrant rivals.
